learning_outcomes.text: Distinguish between a discrete event system and a continuous system.
Model a discrete event system using ordinary Petri nets.
Evaluate the performance of a discrete event system.
Analyze and propose improvements to optimize the system's performance.
Identify the difference between a discrete event system and a continuous system.
Assimilate the principles of ordinary Petri nets, their definitions, and properties.
Understand performance evaluation methods applied to discrete event systems.
Be able to model a discrete event system using ordinary Petri nets.
Analyze the performance of the modeled system.
Propose improvement strategies to optimize system performances.
Develop rigor in analyzing the performance of discrete event systems.
Be aware of the challenges related to optimizing production systems.
Apply these skills in an industrial context while emphasizing process efficiency.

syllabus_topics: General presentation of discrete event systems
Fundamentals of Petri Nets: Definitions and basic concepts
Fundamental properties (liveness, boundedness, blocking, reinitialization, etc.)
TD 1: Modeling and marking graph of Petri nets
TD 2: Analysis of properties and network reduction
TD 3: Application of Petri nets to performance evaluation
teaching_methods: Tutorials (TD): Solving practical exercises and case studies
bibliography: René David, Hassane Alla. Du Grafcet au réseaux de Petri. Editions HERMES, 2ème édition, 1997.
Annie Choquet-Geniet. Les réseaux de Petri : Un outil de modélisation Cours et exercices corrigés. Dunod, 2006.
Wolfgang Reisig. Understanding Petri Nets: Modeling Techniques, Analysis Methods, Case Studies. Springer, 2013
degree: Titre d'ingénieur ENIT (cycle ingénieur, semestres 5-10; orientación mecánica/producción)
